Questions

choices.html: he was cheering for his dad.

questions.prompt: What happened when John met Nicholas Cage?

choices.html: Nicholas Cage was friendly but didn't let John take a photo.
John couldn't take a photo because there were too many people.
John took a photo with Nicholas Cage, who was friendly.

questions.prompt: What is NOT true about John and his broken bone?

choices.html: He broke it while riding his bike.
He has climbed Snowdon in the rain.
He has climbed Scottish mountains in the rain.
He sent Sally a Valentine's Day card earlier this year.
He has never sent a Valentine's Day card to Sally.
He sent a Valentine's Day card last year, but not this year.
